dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: I love it! It feels... just like home.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: I've spent quite a bit of time in other nations, so I'm used to many different aesthetics.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: But, that's not why this place feels so comforting...

choices.text: Oh? Then what is it about this place?

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: But, as a well-traveled individual, your wealth of diverse experiences have subconsciously shaped your idea of "home."

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: As you decorated this space, those subconscious ideas likely guided your decisions... Almost like a form of "inspiration," if you will.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Similarly, another area influenced by our subconscious... is the wondrous and mystifying realm of our dreams.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Oho, that was fast. So, what is your interpretation?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The Realm Within is a kind of dream?

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: Simply put, to a certain extent, this place is a reflection of your hopes and desires... And, things we wish for are very likely to appear in our dreams.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: So, in that sense, this place is like a preview of your dreams — an area that is very familiar to me, of course.

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: If I analyze this place, I bet I could even learn a little secret or two...

response.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
response.text: It's a bit complicated. We don't need to get into the theory behind it.

choices.text: So, it's not about how this place looks...
